text: わかって　るよね　ポケモンに　ずるは　なし　だよ！

structure.jp: ポケモンに　ずるは　なし　だよ！

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: The て-form plus いる shows a state that is true now; in casual speech the い drops, giving てる. わかってる = 'you know'.

patterns.name: 〜よね
patterns.explanation: よね at the end checks that the listener agrees with something the speaker is fairly sure of. わかってるよね = 'you know, right?'
